text: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group's largest shareholders as of March 31, 2026 are trust and custody banks: The Master Trust Bank of Japan (16.15%) and Custody Bank of Japan (5.79%), ahead of State Street Bank and Trust Company (2.82%).
short: SMFG's largest shareholders are trust and custody banks.
